note: Ratio Crop provides one configurable core image effect, image_crop_ratio ('Ratio crop'), plus a bundled GD toolkit operation gd_crop_ratio (operation 'crop_ratio'). It has no configure route, no permissions, no services and no settings form; all state lives inside an image style config entity (image.style.<name>) as an effect with data.aspect_ratio ('W:H') and data.anchor. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real image styles created/inspected on the live site; everything is local (no external services).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I want to crop images to a fixed aspect ratio using the ratio_crop module. Which image effect plugin do I add to an image style, and what is the machine name I would see in the exported image style config?
evals.expected_output: You add the 'Ratio crop' effect, whose plugin id is image_crop_ratio, to an image style at /admin/config/media/image-styles. In exported config it appears under effects.<uuid>.id: image_crop_ratio.

evals.prompt: What configuration does the ratio_crop 'Ratio crop' image effect take, and in what format is the aspect ratio entered?
evals.expected_output: It takes two keys: aspect_ratio, a 'W:H' string like 16:9 (validated against ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$, default 1:1), and anchor, one of the nine grid positions (left-top ... center-center ... right-bottom, default center-center) that decides which part of the image is kept.

evals.prompt: The ratio_crop module's image effect does not crop pixels itself. Which image toolkit operation does it delegate to, and which core module does ratio_crop depend on?
evals.expected_output: The effect calls the bundled GD toolkit operation gd_crop_ratio (operation name crop_ratio), which subclasses core's GD Crop and uses PHP imagecrop(). The module depends only on core's image module.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an image style named ratiocrop_known that uses the ratio_crop module. Inspect the live image style configuration and state the aspect ratio its Ratio crop effect is set to.
evals.expected_output: The ratiocrop_known image style has an image_crop_ratio effect with data.aspect_ratio '4:3' (anchor left-top).

evals.prompt: The image style ratiocrop_anchor on this site crops to a fixed ratio with the ratio_crop module. Inspect the live configuration and state which anchor (which part of the image is kept) its Ratio crop effect uses.
evals.expected_output: The ratiocrop_anchor image style's image_crop_ratio effect has data.anchor 'right-bottom'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create an image style with the machine name ratiocrop_task that uses the ratio_crop module to crop images to a 16:9 aspect ratio, keeping the centre of the image (anchor center-center). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An image style image.style.ratiocrop_task exists with an effect id image_crop_ratio whose data.aspect_ratio is '16:9' and data.anchor is 'center-center'.

evals.prompt: I need square thumbnails on my Drupal site, but faces at the top of portrait photos keep getting cut off. Using the ratio_crop module, create an image style called ratiocrop_square that crops to a square and keeps the top-centre of each image. Save it on the site.
evals.expected_output: An image style image.style.ratiocrop_square exists with an image_crop_ratio effect whose data.aspect_ratio is '1:1' and data.anchor is 'center-top'.
